⚠ **SETUP FIRST — needs a separate PostgreSQL 16 container.** Install a `postgres:16-alpine` container (set POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD / POSTGRES_DB), then point media-vault's DB fields at it. It won't start without a reachable database.
media-vault is a self-hosted, open-source catalog for your **physical media** — video games, movies, vinyl LPs/singles and CDs — all on one shelf.
**Highlights** - Automatic artwork: covers, ratings and descriptions fetched per media type (IGDB for games, TMDB for movies, Discogs for vinyl/CD). - Signature spine-shelf view plus a gallery grid. - Barcode add (camera or USB scanner), CSV import/export, wishlist, bundle checker and a games catalogue with ownership overlay. - Optional valuation (Discogs marketplace; PriceCharting for games).
**Requires a separate PostgreSQL 16 container** — install `postgres:16-alpine` first, then point media-vault's DB variables at it.
📖 Setup guide: https://github.com/halvar20000/media-vault/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
Issues and support: https://github.com/halvar20000/media-vault/issues
